fusions.name: Crack from the Reeds
fusions.desc: Looses a shot from the waterline that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores its armour. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Gizzard Grapeshot
fusions.desc: Spits 5 swallowed stones at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Your abilities reach 43% further for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Wait
fusions.desc: After a run of strikes with no critical hit, your next strike has 40% more critical chance. Once every 10 seconds.
